escena: SCENE (paper and finish selection, bindery in Lima, morning, NO FACES): a hard shaft of window light falls across the worktop; the frame is filled by TWO PAIRS OF HANDS working over a lit surface — one pair fans out a stack of paper swatches while the other pulls one sample halfway out at the instant of choosing it, a thumb pressing the grain to feel the texture. Only forearms enter the frame; no faces, no heads, no bodies. Real hands with visible skin texture, short clean nails, a worn wedding band, fine creases. 100mm lens at f/4, camera low and close over the worktop, focus on the chosen swatch. Everything is completely unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the dark walnut worktop, a hand's width from the lens, in shadow
